title: grumilea subalpina
intro: Grumilea subalpina, commonly known as Mountain mint, is a plant species native to the mountainous regions of Africa. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Studies have identified the therapeutic actions of Grumilea subalpina, which include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
